channel.title: Hudhud's Story Time
channel.description: Grandpa and Grandma tell true stories from islam.museum for curious kids: inventors, travellers, doctors and mapmakers from fourteen centuries of Islamic history. Every story links back to its page in the museum, where families can explore more in the Kids' Wing. Voices are AI-generated.
channel.itunes:author: islam.museum

item.title: The Silver Map
item.description: Grandma and Grandpa tell the story of al-Idrisi, who spent fifteen years at a kings court in Sicily drawing the whole world, and engraved it on a disc of silver. A true story from islam.museum, told for curious kids. Voices are AI-generated. Read the full story at islam.museum: https://islam.museum/en/person/al-idrisi-muhammad-ibn-abd-allah/
